#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build and check the real AppKit controls using isolated, synthetic browser state."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--objects", type=pathlib.Path, help="Use existing Release object files instead of building")
parser.add_argument("--output", type=pathlib.Path, help="Keep captures and benchmark samples in this directory")
parser.add_argument("--baseline", action="store_true", help="Check the original implementation without optimization assertions")
parser.add_argument("--browser", action="store_true", help="Check history search and complete browser actions using local data")
parser.add_argument("--startup", action="store_true", help="Measure startup in fresh processes: 2 warmups and 9 samples")
parser.add_argument("--runs", type=int, default=15, help="Measured samples per workload (default: 15)")
parser.add_argument("--warmups", type=int, default=4, help="Warmup samples per workload (default: 4)")
parser.add_argument("--compile-only", action="store_true", help="Save the test executable in --output for paired process runs")
parser.add_argument("--paired-baseline", type=pathlib.Path, help="Compare all suites with these baseline object files")
parser.add_argument("--pairs", type=int, default=6, help="Alternating before/after process pairs (default: 6)")
parser.add_argument("--allow-visible-tests", action="store_true", help="Explicitly permit foreground window changes and animations")
parser.add_argument("--offscreen", action="store_true", help="Block window presentation and activation; exclude live frame pacing")
args = parser.parse_args()
if args.offscreen and args.allow_visible_tests:
    parser.error("--offscreen cannot be combined with --allow-visible-tests")
if (args.browser or args.startup or args.paired_baseline) and not args.compile_only and not args.allow_visible_tests and not args.offscreen:
    parser.error("Visible browser/startup tests are disabled. Obtain explicit approval before using --allow-visible-tests.")
if not 1 <= args.runs <= 1000 or not 0 <= args.warmups <= 100:
    parser.error("--runs must be 1–1000 and --warmups must be 0–100")
if args.compile_only and not args.output:
    parser.error("--compile-only requires --output")
if args.paired_baseline and (not args.output or args.compile_only or args.browser or args.startup or args.baseline):
    parser.error("--paired-baseline requires --output and cannot be combined with individual suite modes")
if not 2 <= args.pairs <= 30:
    parser.error("--pairs must be 2–30")
if args.browser and args.startup:
    parser.error("Choose either --browser or --startup")
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="brook-ui-check-") as temporary:
    temporary = pathlib.Path(temporary)
    objects = args.objects
    if objects is None:
        with (temporary / "build.log").open("w+") as log:
            try:
                subprocess.run(["xcodegen", "generate"], cwd=root, stdout=log, stderr=log, check=True)
                subprocess.run(["xcodebuild", "-project", "Brook.xcodeproj", "-scheme", "Brook", "-configuration", "Release",
                                "-derivedDataPath", "build", "CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=-", "build"],
                               cwd=root, stdout=log, stderr=log, check=True)
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
                log.seek(0)
                print(log.read())
                raise
        objects = root / "build/Build/Intermediates.noindex/Brook.build/Release/Brook.build/Objects-normal/arm64"
    files = sorted(str(p.resolve()) for p in objects.glob("*.o") if p.name != "main.o")
    if not files:
        parser.error(f"No object files found in {objects}")
    command = ["xcrun", "clang++", "-std=c++23", "-O2", "-fobjc-arc", "-fmodules", "-Wno-deprecated-declarations"]
    for directory in sorted((root / "Sources").iterdir()):
        if directory.is_dir():
            command += ["-I", str(directory)]
    command += [str(root / "scripts/check-ui.mm"), *files]
    for framework in ["AppKit", "WebKit", "QuartzCore", "CoreGraphics", "Security", "LocalAuthentication",
                      "UniformTypeIdentifiers", "UserNotifications"]:
        command += ["-framework", framework]
    executable = temporary / "check-ui"
    subprocess.run([*command, "-lsqlite3", "-o", str(executable)], check=True)
    output = args.output.resolve() if args.output else temporary / "results"
    if args.compile_only:
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(executable, output / "check-ui")
        raise SystemExit(0)
    environment = {**os.environ, "BROOK_CHECK_RUNS": str(args.runs), "BROOK_CHECK_WARMUPS": str(args.warmups),
                   "BROOK_ALLOW_VISIBLE_TESTS": "1" if args.allow_visible_tests else "0"}
    if args.paired_baseline:
        baseline_files = sorted(str(p.resolve()) for p in args.paired_baseline.glob("*.o") if p.name != "main.o")
        if not baseline_files:
            parser.error(f"No baseline object files found in {args.paired_baseline}")
        baseline_command = [part for part in command if part not in files]
        baseline_executable = temporary / "check-ui-baseline"
        subprocess.run([*baseline_command, *baseline_files, "-lsqlite3", "-o", str(baseline_executable)], check=True)
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        evidence = {"protocol": {"pairs": args.pairs, "runs": args.runs, "warmups": args.warmups,
                                 "order": "AB then BA, alternating", "startup_runs": 30, "startup_warmups": 4,
                                 "offscreen": args.offscreen},
                    "trials": [], "startup": {"before": [], "after": []}}
        executables = {"before": baseline_executable, "after": executable}
        def save():
            (output / "paired-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + "\n")
        for pair in range(args.pairs):
            order = ("before", "after") if pair % 2 == 0 else ("after", "before")
            for suite in ("ui", "browser"):
                for variant in order:
                    destination = output / f"{pair}-{suite}-{variant}"
                    destination.mkdir()
                    with (destination / "run.log").open("w") as log:
                        subprocess.run([str(executables[variant]), str(destination),
                                        *(["--baseline"] if variant == "before" else []),
                                        *(["--offscreen"] if args.offscreen else []),
                                        *(["--browser"] if suite == "browser" else [])],
                                       env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=log, check=True, timeout=1200)
                    samples = json.loads((destination / ("timings.json" if suite == "ui" else "browser-timings.json")).read_text())
                    assert all(len(values) == args.runs for values in samples.values())
                    evidence["trials"].append({"pair": pair, "suite": suite, "variant": variant,
                                               "directory": destination.name, "samples": samples})
                    save()
                    print(f"Pair {pair + 1}/{args.pairs}: {suite} {variant} passed", flush=True)
        bundle = root / "build/Build/Products/Release/Brook.app"
        for run in range(34):
            order = ("before", "after") if run % 2 == 0 else ("after", "before")
            for variant in order:
                destination = output / f"startup-{run}-{variant}"
                destination.mkdir()
                with (destination / "run.log").open("w") as log:
                    subprocess.run([str(executables[variant]), str(destination), "--startup", *(["--offscreen"] if args.offscreen else [])],
                                   env={**environment, "BROOK_UI_CHECK_BUNDLE": str(bundle)},
                                   stdout=log, stderr=log, check=True, timeout=90)
                if run >= 4:
                    value = json.loads((destination / "startup.json").read_text())["startup_to_first_window_submission_ms"]
                    evidence["startup"][variant].append(value)
            save()
        print("All paired suites and 30 measured startup pairs passed.", flush=True)
    elif args.startup:
        bundle = root / "build/Build/Products/Release/Brook.app"
        if not bundle.is_dir():
            parser.error("Build the Release app first; the startup check uses its bundled resources")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        samples = []
        for run in range(11):
            destination = temporary / f"startup-{run}"
            subprocess.run([str(executable), str(destination), "--startup", *(["--offscreen"] if args.offscreen else [])], check=True,
                           env={**environment, "BROOK_UI_CHECK_BUNDLE": str(bundle)})
            result = json.loads((destination / "startup.json").read_text())
            if run >= 2:
                samples.append(result["startup_to_first_window_submission_ms"])
        (output / "startup-timings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"warmups": 2, "samples_ms": samples}, indent=2) + "\n")
    else:
        subprocess.run([str(executable), str(output), *(["--baseline"] if args.baseline else []),
                        *(["--offscreen"] if args.offscreen else []),
                        *(["--browser"] if args.browser else [])], check=True, env=environment)

import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import math
import statistics as st
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = Path('/Users/xxxxxxxxxx/Documents/Coding/Brook/brook')
CHARTS = Path('/Users/xxxxxxxxxx/.codex/visualizations/2026/09/29/01a0eef1-a5a7-7972-b057-9afee4a34f30/brook-regression-fixes-20261001')
OLD = CHARTS.parent / 'brook-benchmark-charts-interrupted-20261001'
full = json.loads((P / 'full-comparison/paired-results.json').read_text())
settings = json.loads((P / 'settled-settings-results.json').read_text())
assert len(full['trials']) == 16 and len(settings) == 8
assert all(len(v) == 30 for v in full['startup'].values())

def stats(a):
    a = sorted(a)
    return {'median_ms':st.median(a), 'p95_ms':a[math.ceil(.95*len(a))-1], 'min_ms':a[0], 'max_ms':a[-1], 'cv_percent':st.stdev(a)/st.mean(a)*100, 'samples':len(a)}

def compare(before, after, pair_logs, dataset):
    # Four suite pairs have only 256 possible bootstrap resamples; enumerate all of them.
    if len(pair_logs) == 4:
        boot = sorted(st.mean(sample) for sample in itertools.product(pair_logs, repeat=4))
    else:
        import random
        rng = random.Random(20261001)
        boot = sorted(st.mean(rng.choices(pair_logs, k=len(pair_logs))) for _ in range(20000))
    low, high = [100*math.expm1(boot[int(q*(len(boot)-1))]) for q in [.025,.975]]
    a, b = st.median(before), st.median(after)
    return {'before_ms':a, 'now_ms':b, 'observed_change_percent':100*(b/a-1),
            'paired_change_interval_95_percent':[low,high],
            'trend':'REPEATABLE_INCREASE' if low>0 else 'REPEATABLE_DECREASE' if high<0 else 'UNCERTAIN',
            'status':'MEASURED', 'dataset':dataset,
            'statistics':{'before':stats(before),'after':stats(after)},
            'samples_ms':{'before':before,'after':after}, 'pair_log_ratios':pair_logs}

scores = {}
for suite in ['ui','browser']:
    trials = [t for t in full['trials'] if t['suite']==suite]
    for key in trials[0]['samples']:
        chosen = settings if key.startswith('settings_') else trials
        values = {v:[n for t in chosen if t['variant']==v for n in t['samples'][key]] for v in ['before','after']}
        logs = []
        for pair in range(4):
            pair_values={t['variant']:st.median(t['samples'][key]) for t in chosen if t['pair']==pair}
            logs.append(math.log(pair_values['after']/pair_values['before']))
        scores[key]=compare(values['before'],values['after'],logs,'settled_settings' if key.startswith('settings_') else suite)
a,b=full['startup']['before'],full['startup']['after']
scores['startup_to_first_window_submission_ms']=compare(a,b,[math.log(y/x) for x,y in zip(a,b)],'offscreen_startup')
assert len(scores)==65

pixels={}
for kind, count in [('ui',248),('browser',11),('settings',10)]:
    for pair in range(4):
        root=P if kind=='settings' else P/'full-comparison'
        prefix=f'settings-{pair}' if kind=='settings' else f'{pair}-{kind}'
        before=root/(prefix+'-before');after=root/(prefix+'-after')
        names=sorted(f.name for f in before.glob('*.png'))
        assert len(names)==count
        details={}
        for name in names:
            x=Image.open(before/name).convert('RGBA');y=Image.open(after/name).convert('RGBA')
            details[name]={'equal':x.size==y.size and x.tobytes()==y.tobytes(), 'before_size':x.size,'after_size':y.size,
                           'before_pixel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(x.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                           'after_pixel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(y.tobytes()).hexdigest()}
        pixels[f'{kind}-{pair}']=details
matches=sum(d['equal'] for group in pixels.values() for d in group.values())
comparisons=sum(map(len,pixels.values()))
assert comparisons==1076
final_pixels=[d for name,group in pixels.items() for file,d in group.items() if not name.startswith('browser-') or file=='browser-history-suggestions.png']
final_matches=sum(d['equal'] for d in final_pixels)
assert len(final_pixels)==1036

metadata=json.loads((P/'metadata.json').read_text())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((REPO/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for f,h in metadata['final_sha256'].items())
output={'status':'ZERO_REGRESSION_NOT_ESTABLISHED','date':'2026-10-01','scores':scores,
        'full_protocol':json.loads((P/'protocol.json').read_text()),'raw_full_comparison':full,
        'settled_settings_protocol':{'pairs':4,'measured_samples_per_process':7,'warmups':2,
            'condition':'Selected pane attached to its window and every inactive loaded pane detached, verified before each prepare and after its transition.',
            'statistics':'Exact enumeration of all 256 resamples of four paired process-median log ratios; central 95% interval. Startup uses 20,000 paired resamples, seed 20261001. Exploratory intervals are not adjusted for 65 simultaneous comparisons.'},
        'raw_settled_settings':settings,'pixel_checks':pixels,'pixel_matches':final_matches,'pixel_comparisons':len(final_pixels),'all_capture_matches':matches,'all_capture_comparisons':comparisons,
        'metadata':metadata,'production_patch':(P/'final.patch').read_text(), 'prior_production_patch':(P/'before.patch').read_text(),
        'full_harness':(P/'final-harness.mm').read_text(),'full_runner':(P/'final-runner.py').read_text(),
        'settled_harness':(REPO/'scripts/check-ui.mm').read_text(),
        'rejected_row_pooling_trials':json.loads((P/'candidate-ui.json').read_text()),
        'settings_diagnostic':json.loads((P/'settled-pilot/browser-details.json').read_text()),
        'builds':{'release':'passed','debug':'passed','analysis':'passed with 40 existing diagnostics','compiler':'2 existing WKProcessPool deprecation warnings','codesign':'passed','plist':'passed'},
        'limitations':['No visible tests were run. Window ordering and application activation were blocked.',
            'No live frame-pacing, onscreen compositor or real window-activation result is claimed.',
            'Hidden command-bar timing does not exercise its visibility-dependent dismissal path.',
            'WebKit script round-trip latency is not scrolling frame time and has no identified Brook-code cause.',
            'Settings timings from the first full comparison used overlapping transitions and are superseded by the settled-state comparison.',
            'This is a shared desktop; samples include scheduling variation and no samples were deleted.',
            'Real credential, biometric, external-network and third-party extension integration were excluded.'],
        'logs':{str(f.relative_to(P)):f.read_text(errors='replace') for f in P.glob('**/run.log')},
        'analyzer_log':(P/'build-debug-analyze.log').read_text()}
output['higher_medians']=[k for k,s in scores.items() if s['now_ms']>s['before_ms']]
output['repeatable_increases']=[k for k,s in scores.items() if s['trend']=='REPEATABLE_INCREASE']
(REPO/'outputs/browser-regression-fixes-20261001.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
CHARTS.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(CHARTS/'scores.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scores':scores},indent=2)+'\n')
groups=json.loads((OLD/'groups.json').read_text())
groups[2][3].insert(0,['command_bar_recent_rows_100','Command-bar rows · 100 refreshes'])
for group in groups:
    group[2]='Offscreen · 48 samples per version; settings 28; startup 30 · median milliseconds'
    for row in group[3]:
        if row[0]=='startup_to_first_window_submission_ms':row[1]='Startup setup · hidden window'
        if row[0]=='command_bar_open_close':row[1]='Command bar · hidden preparation'
        if row[0]=='local_page_scroll_script_round_trip':row[1]='WebKit scroll script round trip'
        if row[0].endswith('menu'):row[1]+=' · batched'
(CHARTS/'groups.json').write_text(json.dumps(groups,indent=2)+'\n')
renderer=(OLD/'render.py').read_text().replace('== 64','== 65')
renderer=renderer.replace("assert sum(s['status'] == 'NOT_RUN' for s in scores.values()) == 1", "assert all(s['status'] == 'MEASURED' for s in scores.values())")
renderer=renderer.replace('BROOK  /  PARTIAL RUN — STOPPED  /  1 OCT 2026','BROOK  /  OFFSCREEN COMPARISON  /  1 OCT 2026')
renderer=renderer.replace('PARTIAL RUN · Observed changes only; confidence analysis unfinished. Negative change = less time. No startup rerun.', 'All timings retained. Brown = higher median. Settings start settled. No live presentation or FPS claim.')
renderer=renderer.replace('ax.set_xlim(0, 165)','axis_max = max(165, math.ceil(max(100*scores[k]["now_ms"]/scores[k]["before_ms"] for k,_ in rows)/50)*50)\n        ax.set_xlim(0, axis_max)')
renderer=renderer.replace('assert 0 < ratio < 165','assert 0 < ratio <= axis_max')
(CHARTS/'render.py').write_text(renderer)
print(json.dumps({'matches':matches,'comparisons':comparisons,'higher_medians':output['higher_medians'],'repeatable_increases':output['repeatable_increases']},indent=2))

import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', str(ROOT.parent / 'brook-benchmark-charts/.matplotlib'))
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')

assert all(s['status'] == 'MEASURED' for s in scores.values())
assert all(math.isfinite(s[k]) and s[k] > 0 for s in scores.values() if s['status'] != 'NOT_RUN' for k in ('before_ms', 'now_ms'))
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans', 'font.size': 11, 'svg.fonttype': 'none'})

with PdfPages(ROOT / 'brook-benchmarks.pdf') as pdf:
    for number, (slug, title, subtitle, rows) in enumerate(groups, 1):
        n = len(rows)
        height = n * .46 + 3.4
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(17, height), facecolor='#FFFFFF')
        top, bottom = 1 - 2 / height, 1.1 / height
        ax = fig.add_axes([.318, bottom, .298, top - bottom])
        axis_max = max(165, math.ceil(max(100*scores[k]["now_ms"]/scores[k]["before_ms"] for k,_ in rows)/50)*50)
        ax.set_xlim(0, axis_max)
        ax.set_ylim(n - .5, -.5)
        ax.set_xticks([0, 50, 100, 150], ['0%', '50%', '100%', '150%'])
        ax.tick_params(axis='x', length=0, colors='#667085', pad=8)
        ax.set_yticks([])
        for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False)
        ax.set_axisbelow(True)
        ax.grid(axis='x', color='#EAECF0', linewidth=.8)
        ax.axvline(100, color='#98A2B3', linewidth=1, linestyle=(0, (3, 3)), zorder=1)
        fig.text(.035, 1 - .34 / height, 'BROOK  /  OFFSCREEN COMPARISON  /  1 OCT 2026', fontsize=10, weight='bold', color='#667085')
        fig.text(.035, 1 - .81 / height, title, fontsize=27, weight='bold', color='#101828')
        fig.text(.035, 1 - 1.13 / height, subtitle, fontsize=12, color='#475467')
        fig.text(.965, 1 - .77 / height, f'{number} / 4', ha='right', fontsize=12, color='#667085')
        fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor='#D0D5DD', label='Before · original 550abac'), Patch(facecolor='#245B85', label='After · current optimizations')],
                   loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(.03, 1 - 1.31 / height), ncol=2, frameon=False, fontsize=10, handlelength=1.2, columnspacing=2.3)
        for x, label, align in [(.035, 'WORKLOAD', 'left'), (.318, 'TIME RELATIVE TO BEFORE', 'left'), (.700, 'BEFORE (ms)', 'right'), (.790, 'AFTER (ms)', 'right'), (.827, 'OBSERVED CHANGE', 'left')]:
            fig.text(x, top + .12 / height, label, fontsize=9, weight='bold', color='#667085', ha=align)
        for i, (key, label) in enumerate(rows):
            s = scores[key]
            y = top - (i + .5) / n * (top - bottom)
            fig.text(.035, y, label, va='center', color='#344054', fontsize=11)
            if s['status'] == 'NOT_RUN':
                for x in [.700, .790]: fig.text(x, y, '—', ha='right', va='center', color='#667085')
                fig.text(.827, y, 'Not run', va='center', color='#667085', weight='bold')
                continue
            ratio = 100 * s['now_ms'] / s['before_ms']
            assert 0 < ratio <= axis_max
            ax.barh(i - .155, 100, height=.24, color='#D0D5DD', zorder=2)
            ax.barh(i + .155, ratio, height=.24, color='#245B85', zorder=3)
            for x, field in [(.700, 'before_ms'), (.790, 'now_ms')]:
                text = f'{s[field]:.{6 if s[field] < .01 else 3}f}'
                fig.text(x, y, text, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=11, color='#344054', weight='bold' if field == 'now_ms' else 'normal')
            change = ratio - 100
            label = '>99.9% lower' if change < -99.9 else f'{change:+.1f}%'
            fig.text(.827, y, label, va='center', color='#9A4D13' if change > 0 else '#245B85', fontsize=11, weight='bold')
        fig.text(.035, .55 / height, '100% = original code for each workload. Shorter bars = less time. Numbers are median milliseconds.', fontsize=10, color='#475467')
        fig.text(.035, .29 / height, 'All timings retained. Brown = higher median. Settings start settled. No live presentation or FPS claim.', fontsize=9, color='#667085')
        fig.savefig(ROOT / f'{slug}.png', dpi=160, facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
        fig.savefig(ROOT / f'{slug}.svg', facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
        pdf.savefig(fig, facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
        plt.close(fig)
print('Rendered four static bar charts and a four-page PDF. No windows opened.')
